title: ArcSlayer
tagline: It's a PvP multiplayer FPS game where you can chill in the metaverse or fight in arena!!
description:
Dive into an immersive PvP multiplayer FPS game that seamlessly blends intense arena battles with the relaxed social atmosphere of the metaverse. Whether you want to chill with friends in virtual hangouts or engage in fierce combat, our game offers the best of both worlds.

Dual Experience: Switch effortlessly between socializing in the metaverse and fighting in high-stakes PvP arenas.
Metaverse Chill Zones: Explore diverse environments where you can meet other players, customize avatars, and enjoy interactive activities.
Intense Arena Battles: Test your skills in various arenas with fast-paced, competitive FPS action.
Customization: Personalize your in-game appearance and loadouts to stand out in both the metaverse and the battlefield.
Community Driven: Engage with a vibrant community of players through events, tournaments, and social hubs.
how_its_made:
This project is made using the unity and chainsafe SDK for web3 integration of game..also I have used the MONA SDK for for making the metaverse..I have used PUN photon SDK for multiplayer networking of the game.
And I have added chainsafe SDK for user login and NFTs and stuff from the marketplace.
